speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: Your blood sugar is critically low at 41 mg/dL, which explains the confusion, abdominal pain, and vomiting. Since your C-peptide is normal, ruling out an insulinoma, this is likely late dumping syndrome exacerbated by your recent sleeve gastrectomy and diabetic medication. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypoglycemia secondary to dumping syndrome
